text:
Lina - Product: @channel announcement: we're rolling out the Private Data Lifecycle & Customer Delete API policy for Private/VPC/on-prem customers. Effective 2026-08-01. Purpose: give customers deterministic control over data retention and a supported delete pathway that complies with regional regulations. TL;DR below + action items.

Noah - Eng-API: quick q — does this require schema changes to the private control plane API?

Lina - Product: yes — we'll add a namespaced DELETE endpoint for customer-managed blobs and a signed purge-job workflow for on-prem images. On hosted plane we already have deletion primitives; this formalizes behavior and SLA for Private.

Aya - Eng-Security: we should require an authenticated attest token for delete requests and emit an auditable event. Also retention markers must be immutable once set unless an admin-rollback is performed with 2-person approval.

Marco - Legal: note on lawful-hold: customers can request a hold that prevents deletion; we'll add contract language and an API flag `legal_hold` to accompany requests. Legal to provide standard text for machine-readable acceptance.

Priya - Customer Success: need a customer communications pack + step-by-step for account owners. Also ask: are we supporting self-service deletion for high-touch enterprise accounts?

Lina - Product: two modes: (A) Self-service delete for customers with RBAC > admin on their Private control plane; (B) Assisted delete for customers that want Redwood to run the purge (requires signed attestation and support T&Cs). For assisted deletes we require vendor attestation + customer written consent.

Noah - Eng-API: API example draft:```
POST /private/v1/objects/delete-job
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, X-Attestation: <sig>
Body: { "objects": ["s3://customer-bucket/12345","/var/redwood/kvs/cluster-7/*"], "retention_cutoff": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z", "requester": "acct-789" }
Response: { "job_id": "del-job-2026-07-01-xyz", "status": "queued", "estimated_completion": "2026-07-02T03:00:00Z" }
```

Aya - Eng-Security: audit events: `private.delete.requested`, `private.delete.executed`, `private.delete.denied`. All events require signed proofs that we store in internal audit log (immutable S3 + manifest hash).

support-bot: Note: feature flag `private.delete_api_v1` enabled in staging at 2026-04-25T11:05Z.

Lina - Product: Action items (owners + due dates):
- Eng-API (Noah) -> implement DELETE job endpoint, attest-token validation, job runner + job statuses -> due 2026-06-15
- Eng-Security (Aya) -> attestation format + audit-event schema + 2-person admin approval flow -> due 2026-05-20
- Legal (Marco) -> contract addendum, lawful-hold clause, consent template -> due 2026-05-01
- CS (Priya) -> customer communications pack, self-service guide, assisted-delete playbook -> due 2026-06-01
- Sales (sophie.sales) -> quote language + SKU for assisted delete service -> due 2026-05-18
- Support (support-bot/Tom) -> runbooks for assisted purge and escalation matrix -> due 2026-06-05

Priya - Customer Success: I'll schedule a webinar for customers who have private clusters and a FAQ draft by next week.

Marco - Legal: also flagging data residency interactions: if a customer requests deletion of objects replicated across regions, we'll need a canonical region for purge to avoid inconsistencies. We'll include guidance in the addendum.

Noah - Eng-API: question — do we allow a dry-run mode that reports objects that would be deleted?

Lina - Product: yes, add `dry_run=true` to the delete-job; job should return `candidates` + size estimate without mutating state. Good idea.

Aya - Eng-Security: we will add rate-limits and large-purge throttles; any purge > 1TB must be scheduled and will require a security review.

Lina - Product: We'll cover this in next Private product sync (Tuesday 10am PT). Please DM for blockers. Thanks team — this should give customers a clearer, auditable way to meet deletion requests while preserving necessary legal safeguards. :white_check_mark:
